function printHidden(value: object): void { console.dir(value, { showHidden: true }); }
const p = { constructor: Number, x: 1 };
const custom = Object.create(p);
printHidden(custom);
console.log('%o', custom);
printHidden(Object.create({ constructor: Math.max, value: 1 }));
const builtinName = { constructor: Number, hidden: 2 };
const mathName = { constructor: Math.max, shown: 3 };
printHidden(Object.create(Object.assign(Object.create(builtinName), { near: 4 })));
printHidden(Object.create(Object.assign(Object.create(mathName), { near: 5 })));
const PretendBuiltin = function Number() {};
(PretendBuiltin.prototype as { ignored?: number }).ignored = 6;
printHidden(Object.create(PretendBuiltin.prototype));
printHidden(Object.create(Object.assign(Object.create(PretendBuiltin.prototype), { near: 7 })));
const PretendNamed = function Custom() {};
(PretendNamed.prototype as { visible?: number }).visible = 8;
printHidden(Object.create(PretendNamed.prototype));
const renamed = Math.min;
Object.defineProperty(renamed, 'name', { value: 'Number' });
printHidden(Object.create(Object.assign(Object.create({ constructor: renamed, hidden: 9 }), { near: 10 })));
printHidden(Object.create({ constructor: renamed, shown: 11 }));
printHidden(Object.create(Object.assign(Object.create(Object.create({ tooDeep: 12 })), { near: 13 })));
Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, 'listMarker', { value: 14, configurable: true });
printHidden([1]);
printHidden(Object.create(Array.prototype));
Object.defineProperty(Array.prototype, 'constructor', { value: Math.max, configurable: true });
printHidden([1]);
